items.headline: Earnings call transcript: Bathurst Resources lifts q1 EBITDA 80% in FY2027 By Investing.com
items.summary: Bathurst Resources said first-quarter EBITDA rose 80% from a year earlier as stronger export pricing helped offset higher rail, port and fuel costs, while the New Zealand coal miner kept its full-year guidance unchanged.
